FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY
&
CENTRE OF ADVANCED STUDIES IN CHEMISTRY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160 014
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Project Research Scientist-I (non-
medical) in the ICMR-Adhoc research project entitled “Establishment of vaccine candidate underpinning
TLR and NLR dependent regulation of the immune response in visceral Leishmaniasis” under the joint
supervision of Dr. Deepak B. Salunke, Assistant Professor, Department of Chemistry and Prof. Sukhbir
Kaur, Department of Zoology, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Essential Qualification:
First Class Post Graduate Degree in Chemistry (M.Sc., preferably in Organic Chemistry) including the
integrated PG degree with PhD. The maximum age limit of the candidate should be 35 years.
Preference will be given to the candidates with research experience in the field of organic total synthesis
or medicinal chemistry.
Fellowship:
Monthly emoluments @ Rs. 56,000/- + 27% HRA = 71,120/- per month shall be as per the ICMR norms;
the duration of the fellowship is for the period of one year and can be extended further based on the
performance of the candidate.
Selection process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview in the office of the Chairperson,
Department of Chemistry, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Applications along with CV, certificates and first page pf the publications may be submitted to the office
of the undersigned by post latest by September 20, 2024. The date and time of the interview will be
informed to the shortlisted candidates by email. No separate interview letters will be issued and no
TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The position is purely on temporary basis and is
coterminous with the project.
Dr. Deepak B. Salunke
Assistant Professor
Department of Chemistry
Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014
salunke@pu.ac.in
